_comment: Only choices that need Karunakar's judgement. Routine reference picks (temple exterior photos) are not listed; they get confirmed in a browser session.

decisions.title: How do we show a deity or linga that has no usable photograph?
affects: EP02 Someshwara linga (S01, S02, S14, S15)
EP05 Lakshmi Narasimha at the first darshan (S05)
facts: Kolanupaka: a 2018 Deccan Chronicle report describes the swayambhu linga as cracked; a temple listing says photography is not allowed inside.
Srikalahasti: published descriptions agree on a spider, two elephant tusks and a five-headed serpent at the base of the linga; sanctum photography is prohibited.
Kanipakam is already settled by the production book: water and the exterior, no invented full-body murti.

options.label: Illustrate from published descriptions, small in frame, with an on-screen 'artistic depiction' note
Never show the murti or linga itself: light, lamps, reactions and the exterior carry it
options.cost: no change; EP04 drops its optional extra still

decisions.recommendation: B for this week. It removes the only identity risk we cannot check from here, and every affected shot still reads through light and reaction.

decisions.title: Kolanupaka exterior reference
facts: The only identified photo set found is Kaladarshana's 'Someswara Temple' pages (copyright Amit Guha): reference only, never reproduced.
The district's general 'Kolanupaka temple' imagery mostly shows the Jain Kulpakji complex, which must not be used.

options.label: Use the Kaladarshana pages as an architecture reference only (not uploaded to the generator, not shown)
Draw a generic Kalyani Chalukya-style courtyard, captioned as an illustration, until we have our own photo

decisions.recommendation: A, provided you are comfortable that a copyrighted photo guides the drawing without being uploaded or reproduced.

decisions.title: EP03 and the temple bulls
facts: Telangana Today (June 2025) reported 27 bull deaths at the temple goshala; the temple planned a veterinary hospital.
The approved script presents the kode mokku as a devotional practice and does not mention the goshala.

options.label: Hold EP03 until you decide whether a line about the animals' care belongs in it
options.cost: EP03 moves out of this week; the other six proceed

decisions.recommendation: Your call. It is not a factual error in the script, but viewers may raise it in comments.

decisions.title: EP07 Puri and EP08 Bhadrachalam scripts
facts: The weekly kit with these two scripts was not attached. Only Puri's opening line and Bhadrachalam's research angle are in the 30-episode plan.
Puri's chariot facts are already verified for the visuals: Nandighosa 16 wheels (red, yellow), Taladhwaja 14 (red, green), Darpadalana 12 (red, black).

options.label: Attach the kit; both join this week's approval
Run the week with five films and move EP07-08 to next week

decisions.recommendation: A if the kit is ready; the batch already treats them as held without stopping the others.
